lead_shelf.title: THYLORA QYRIS QuickCheck
lead_shelf.subtitle: One Decision, Five Passes
lead_shelf.customer_job: Make one real decision you have been carrying, using five passes: Question, Yield, Reason, Inspect, Safeguard.

artifact.format: Self-contained designed HTML, print-to-PDF at letter size
artifact.worked_example: An ordinary repair-or-replace decision on a twelve-year-old car. No politics. No medical content. No customer story, invented or otherwise.
plate_map: 1 · Cover — One Decision Before You Move
2 · QYRIS visual — Question to Yield to Reason to Inspect to Safeguard
3 · QUESTION — what decision are you actually making
4 · YIELD + REASON — what outcome, and why it matters
5 · INSPECT — known, evidence, inference, unknown, connections
6 · SAFEGUARD — must not happen, who is affected, permission, what would stop you
7 · WORKED EXAMPLE
8 · REUSABLE QUICKCHECK — fillable one-plate instrument, with colophon

cover.alt_text: Dark warm cover. Five markers graded from gold to blue run across the middle, labelled Question, Yield, Reason, Inspect and Safeguard, each with a short plain-language note beneath. Title reads One Decision, Five Passes.

store_copy.shelf_line: One decision. Five passes. Then you move.
store_copy.paragraph: You already know the decision. QuickCheck splits it into five passes — Question, Yield, Reason, Inspect, Safeguard — so each pass has somewhere different to go, and the last one has the authority to stop you. Eight designed plates, a worked example run all the way through, and a one-plate version you can reuse for every decision after this one.
what_you_get: 8 designed plates, print or fill on screen
A worked example carried through all five passes
Fields that save in your browser only — nothing is sent anywhere

lead_shelf.customer_value: A decision you have been turning over for weeks either gets made, or turns into a short list of facts to go and get. Both are progress. Neither happens while it stays in your head.
lead_shelf.refund_fit: Digital artifact with immediate delivery. Refundable on request within the standard window where the file could not be opened, was not as described, or was bought in error. Stated plainly at point of sale rather than buried.

price_proposal.note: Proposed. Lowest price on the shelf on purpose: this is the instrument the other two are built on.

store_copy.shelf_line: A loop is a state problem, not an effort problem.
store_copy.paragraph: The login that sends you back to the login. The code that arrives after it expires. You are not failing at this — you are inside a loop, and loops are not beaten by going faster. Stop, capture the state on one card, make exactly one move, and escalate with evidence instead of frustration. Six designed plates, a copy-out escalation script, and a worked example that went from two evenings of clicking to six minutes on a call.
what_you_get: 6 designed plates, print or fill on screen
A state capture card built to be read aloud or pasted into a chat
An escalation script in three variants, copy to clipboard
A worked example carried all the way to a case number

lead_shelf.customer_value: You stop arriving as somebody who cannot log in — a problem support hears a hundred times a day — and start arriving with a named failing step, a timestamp and a test you already ran. Same facts you always had. The card is what makes them usable.
lead_shelf.refund_fit: Digital artifact with immediate delivery. Refundable on request within the standard window where the file could not be opened, was not as described, or was bought in error.

price_proposal.note: Proposed. Carries the escalation script, which is the part customers reuse most.

lead_shelf.subtitle: 10-Minute Evidence Check

store_copy.shelf_line: Ten minutes, eight fields, one purchase.
store_copy.paragraph: Most money is not lost to outright lies. It is lost in the gap between a claim and the evidence for it, and between a price and a total cost. Eight fields, about ten minutes: what is being claimed, who is saying it, what would show it is true, what this really costs over a year, what actually limits you, and what you could not check. Then one of three answers — act, ask, or hold — with a date on it.
what_you_get: 8 designed plates, print or fill on screen
A ten-line total-cost ledger, including what it costs to undo
A worked example, clearly labelled as invented

lead_shelf.customer_value: Either you buy with your eyes open, or you find out in ten minutes that the thing being sold is harder to check than it was made to look. The second outcome is worth more than the price of the product the first time it happens.
lead_shelf.refund_fit: Digital artifact with immediate delivery. Refundable on request within the standard window where the file could not be opened, was not as described, or was bought in error. A product about honest purchasing has to be sold honestly.

price_proposal.note: Proposed. Same tier as Stuck Loop Reset; broadest audience of the three.
